# Turn a CSV into SQL for Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server or BigQuery

> Convert a CSV to SQL: CREATE TABLE with inferred column types plus batched INSERT statements for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server and BigQuery. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [How to import a CSV into a database](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/csv-to-sql-generator/how-to-import-a-csv-into-a-database.html)
